Fudgey Snowballs
By: Kristin Price
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:08pm

Ingredients




2 tablespoons Butter
6 ounces Package Chocolate Chips
1 Egg
1 cup Powdered Sugar
3 cups Miniature Marshmallows
1 cup Flaked Sweetend Coconut

Preparation

1 Melt butter and chocolate chips over low heat. 2 Remove from heat and add marshmallows, egg and powdered sugar. 3 Form small 3" balls. 4 Spoon each ball into coconut, roll to cover and place individually on cookie sheet to cool.

About


This is my grandmother's no-bake cookie recipe. The women in our family get together and make them every year at Christmas time along with our traditional Norwegian cookies, but these are always my favorite! And they are super easy!

Comments:
Melissa Peterman

Sounds like an instant classic for Christmas!
